preflight_requirements: Confirm ap-east-2 is enabled for the AWS account.
Confirm required SKYGRID services are available in ap-east-2 before deployment.
Run least-privilege IAM review for the Taiwan deployment role.
Create or select three-AZ network topology where supported by the workload.
Verify encryption at rest and in transit with Taiwan-resident keys when residency policy requires it.
Verify DNS, health endpoints, logs, alarms, budgets, and cost anomaly alerts.
Run synthetic health, latency, failure, and rollback tests before any live traffic.
Keep production failover operator-gated until health quorum and rollback proof pass.

minimum_pass_conditions: public health endpoint passes from an external observer
at least two independent availability-zone health checks pass
route manifest and policy validation pass
no unresolved security or data-residency exceptions

promotion_gate: Operator must explicitly approve promotion from readiness_only to staging or production.
